page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.4xlarge is an arm64 memory-optimized virtual machine delivered via the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The compute subsystem is driven by AWS Graviton processors operating at a sustained 3.3 GHz clock frequency. It provisions 16 dedicated physical cores corresponding directly to 16 vCPUs, utilizing single-threaded execution without simultaneous multithreading. This layout eliminates contention across logical threads and provides deterministic per-core compute output. The instance does not include dedicated graphics processing units, centering resource allocation entirely on central compute, memory, and high-throughput local disk storage.

Memory provisioning is configured at 128 GB, yielding a high-density 8:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation of 8.0 GB per core. In addition to main system memory, the instance bundles 950 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage. This direct-attached volume provides high-IOPS, low-latency block operations directly on the host, reducing the I/O latency typical of network-attached block devices. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 8 Gbps, supporting stable throughput for cluster communication and client data transport.

By pairing an energy-efficient ARM architecture with integrated NVMe storage, the r9gd.4xlarge achieves strong qualitative resource efficiency compared to general-purpose x86 alternatives with external storage attachments. Architectural trade-offs include the requirement for arm64 binary compatibility and the ephemeral nature of local instance store data, which necessitates external persistence or replication mechanisms. The r9gd.4xlarge fits memory-intensive workloads, including in-memory key-value stores, distributed caching systems, relational databases requiring rapid local temporary storage, and real-time analytics engines.
description: Amazon Web Services r9gd.4xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance powered by the 64-bit ARM architecture on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It integrates 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs clocked at 3.3 GHz, running single-threaded execution without simultaneous multithreading. Paired with 128 GB of system memory, the instance maintains an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage capabilities include a bundled 950 GB local NVMe SSD, providing direct high-throughput storage alongside an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Without integrated GPUs, the instance focuses compute and memory density on data-heavy architectures. The combination of energy-efficient ARM cores and direct-attached NVMe storage delivers high resource efficiency for workloads sensitive to memory capacity and local I/O latency. The r9gd.4xlarge is suited for in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, real-time analytics pipelines, and transactional database applications requiring low-latency scratch storage.
